goal: Tune the ensemble size (num-sub-networks) and KWTA k for the best accuracy-within-latency trade-off.
planned_code_changes: Raise default --kwta-k from 2 to 3 in train.py (single-axis: KWTA aggregation; num_sub_networks held at 3)
success_criteria: training completes and checkpoint metadata records num_sub_networks=3, kwta_k=3
accuracy > 0.958 (beat group best) and move toward 0.969 inherited floor
latency_ms unchanged (~6 ms) — kwta_k only affects post-forward logit aggregation
rollback_plan: If accuracy regresses below 0.958, revert kwta_k to 2 (loop-2 group best). If k=3 underperforms k=1 floor, the finding is that max-KWTA (k=1) remains optimal for 3-head ensembles.
